info.title: Argentina Financial, Tax & Regulatory Data API (ARCA Monotributo, Dólar, IPC, UMA/JUS)
info.description: Automated live JSON API providing Argentine USD exchange rates (Oficial, Blue, MEP, CCL, Cripto, Tarjeta) with FX spread calculations, INDEC monthly inflation (IPC) & BCRA policy rates, 2026 ARCA Monotributo tax brackets (Categories A–K), Legal & Accounting regulatory units (UMA CPACF, UMA CABA, JUS PBA, SMVM), and National Holidays.

get.summary: Get Live USD Exchange Rates & FX Spreads (Oficial, Blue, MEP, CCL, Cripto, Tarjeta)

200.description: Live ARS/USD exchange rates, bid/ask spreads, and gap percentages vs Official rate.
